(6) State the largest remaining uncertainty and which decision it would change. Also write a short human-readable agent-report.md alongside your structured result. Write your structured result as JSON with exactly this shape: {"status": one of "done"|"blocked"|"failed"|"no-evidence" (lowercase, no other values), "summary": a non-empty string}. You may add any other fields you find useful alongside these two required ones.
